default_route_distance.description: Default admin distance for PIM Assert messages. Lower is better.

default_route_metric.description: Default metric for PIM Assert messages. Lower is better.

hello_interval.description: PIM Hello interval in seconds. Do not set lower than 30.

bsr_candidate_priority.description: Priority for Bootstrap Router (BSR) candidate. Higher value means higher priority.

rp_candidate_time.description: Time interval in seconds for RP candidate messages.

rp_candidate_priority.description: Priority for Rendezvous Point (RP) candidate. Lower value means higher priority.

spt_threshold_packets.description: Number of packets to trigger switch to Shortest Path Tree (SPT). 0 means switch after first packet.

spt_threshold_interval.description: Interval in seconds for SPT threshold testing.
